Definition: from G71; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish):--draught.
BiblicalUsage: Agra is a catch — a draught of fishes — and it appears only in the story of the miraculous catch. Jesus tells Simon to launch out and let down the nets, and they enclose a great multitude of fishes, so many the net breaks and the boats begin to sink; and Simon is astonished at the draught.
TheologicalSignificance: A great catch breaking the nets is the sign, and this word only names the haul — Peter's boats sinking is the wonder.
